title: Taskflow WAF
description: Coraza and Caddy telemetry for the Taskflow frontend and backend WAFs. Selected-range overview cards, rule breakdowns, top IPs, and recent detections honor the Application and Client IP filters; pod and infrastructure metrics are service-level. RelevantOnly auditing emits no records for normal successful traffic.

panels.title: Detection-bearing audit records
panels.description: Total Coraza audit records containing rule detections in the selected range, honoring Application and Client IP filters. RelevantOnly auditing records only relevant transactions; normal traffic produces no audit records.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"messages\"" | json client_ip="transaction.client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" [$__range])) or (0 * sum(count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", application=~"$application"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Confirmed interruptions (BLOCK)
panels.description: Audit records explicitly interrupted by Coraza (transaction.is_interrupted=true) in the selected range. A WAF interruption drops or blocks the transaction; it is not inferred from HTTP 403 alone.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"messages\"" | json client_ip="transaction.client_ip", interrupted="transaction.is_interrupted" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | interrupted="true" [$__range])) or (0 * sum(count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", application=~"$application"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Detected without interruption
panels.description: Audit records matching rules where Coraza did not interrupt the request (transaction.is_interrupted=false). Common in detect-only rules or non-disruptive phases.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"messages\"" | json client_ip="transaction.client_ip", interrupted="transaction.is_interrupted" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | interrupted="false" [$__range])) or (0 * sum(count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", application=~"$application"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Interruption rate
panels.description: Percentage of detection-bearing audit records that were interrupted by Coraza. Honors the Application and Client IP filters. Guarded denominator; shows 'No detections' when undefined.

targets.expr: ((sum(count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"messages\"" | json client_ip="transaction.client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" |= "\"is_interrupted\":true" [$__range])) or (0 * sum(count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"messages\"" | json client_ip="transaction.client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" [$__range])))) / (sum(count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"messages\"" | json client_ip="transaction.client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" [$__range])) > 0)) * 100

panels.title: WAF activity over time (audit events vs rule detections)
panels.description: Transactions audited vs rule detections per displayed interval (minimum 5 minutes; wider for long time ranges). Audit events can occur without rule matches (RelevantOnly response criteria). Shows a zero baseline while WAF logs arrive.

targets.expr: sum by (application) (count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"transaction\"" | json client_ip="transaction.client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" [$__interval])) or on (application) (0 * sum by (application) (count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"}[$__interval])))

sum by (application) (count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"messages\"" | json client_ip="transaction.client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" [$__interval])) or on (application) (0 * sum by (application) (count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"}[$__interval])))

panels.title: Top 10 first-matched CRS rules
panels.description: Audit records grouped by the first rule ID and descriptive rule message extracted from Coraza messages. One transaction can match multiple rules; this ranks the primary triggered rule.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (rule_id, rule_msg) (count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", application=~"$application", rule_id=~".+"} |= "\"messages\"" | json client_ip="transaction.client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | regexp `\[msg \\"(?P<rule_msg>[^\\"]+)\\"\]` [$__range])))

panels.title: First-matched rule categories
panels.description: Detected audit records categorized by their first extracted CRS rule family. Local file inclusion (930xxx) includes restricted file access and traversal.

targets.expr: sum by (category) (count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", application=~"$application", rule_id=~".+"} |= "\"messages\"" | json client_ip="transaction.client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | label_format category=`{{ if hasPrefix "942" .rule_id }}SQL injection{{ else if hasPrefix "941" .rule_id }}Cross-site scripting{{ else if hasPrefix "930" .rule_id }}File access / LFI (930xxx){{ else if hasPrefix "931" .rule_id }}Remote file inclusion{{ else if hasPrefix "932" .rule_id }}Command injection{{ else if or (hasPrefix "933" .rule_id) (hasPrefix "934" .rule_id) }}Code injection{{ else if or (hasPrefix "920" .rule_id) (hasPrefix "921" .rule_id) }}Protocol enforcement{{ else if hasPrefix "913" .rule_id }}Scanner detection{{ else }}Other CRS{{ end }}` [$__range]))

panels.title: Top source IPs (ranked subset)
panels.description: Client IPs parsed from transaction.client_ip. Click an IP to investigate in Access Logs or Rate Limits, or to filter this WAF dashboard.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (client_ip) (count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"messages\"" | json client_ip="transaction.client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip!="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" [$__range])))

panels.title: Recent WAF detections (latest 100)
panels.description: Latest 100 matched audit records. Action, IP, and method/URI are placed first for immediate scanning without wrapping. Expand a row for full labels; open the Raw JSON evidence row below for complete stored records.

targets.expr: {job="coraza-waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"messages\"" | json request_method="transaction.request.method", request_uri="transaction.request.uri", client_ip="transaction.client_ip", interrupted="transaction.is_interrupted" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | regexp `\[msg \\"(?P<rule_msg>[^\\"]+)\\"\]` | line_format `{{if eq .interrupted "true"}}BLOCK{{else}}DETECT{{end}} · {{.client_ip}} · {{.request_method}} {{.request_uri}} · CRS {{.rule_id}}: {{.rule_msg}} ({{.application}})`

panels.title: Detection characteristics (methods, paranoia levels, rule families)
WAF rule detections
panels.description: Detected transactions per displayed interval (minimum 5 minutes; wider for long time ranges). Requires Coraza messages[] rule matches. Zero means no detections while WAF logs are arriving; no data means no WAF logs in that interval.

targets.expr: sum by (application) (count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"messages\"" | json client_ip="transaction.client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" [$__interval])) or on (application) (0 * sum by (application) (count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"}[$__interval])))

panels.title: Detections by HTTP method
panels.description: Detected transactions by method per displayed interval (minimum 5 minutes). Sparse bars represent events, not a continuous rate.

targets.expr: sum by (method) (count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", application=~"$application", method=~".+"} |= "\"messages\"" | json client_ip="transaction.client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Audit records containing each paranoia level
panels.description: Counts audit records containing each CRS paranoia-level tag over the selected range. A record can count at several levels; do not add these counts together. An absent count becomes zero only if WAF logs arrived in the 5 minutes ending at the selected range's end; otherwise that level has no data. Historical nonzero counts remain visible.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"messages\"" | json client_ip="transaction.client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" |= "paranoia-level/1" [$__range])) or (0 * sum(count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"}[5m])))

sum(count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"messages\"" | json client_ip="transaction.client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" |= "paranoia-level/2" [$__range])) or (0 * sum(count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"}[5m])))

sum(count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"messages\"" | json client_ip="transaction.client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" |= "paranoia-level/3" [$__range])) or (0 * sum(count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"}[5m])))

sum(count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"messages\"" | json client_ip="transaction.client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" |= "paranoia-level/4" [$__range])) or (0 * sum(count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"}[5m])))

panels.title: First-matched SQL injection
panels.description: Audit records whose first extracted rule is in the SQL injection family, per displayed interval (minimum 5 minutes). Other matching rules in the same record are not counted separately.

targets.expr: sum by (application) (count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", application=~"$application", rule_id=~"942[0-9]{3}"} | json client_ip="transaction.client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" [$__interval])) or on (application) (0 * sum by (application) (count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"}[$__interval])))

panels.title: First-matched XSS, injection & traversal
panels.description: Audit records first matching XSS, traversal, remote file inclusion, command or code injection, per displayed interval (minimum 5 minutes).

targets.expr: sum by (application) (count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", application=~"$application", rule_id=~"941[0-9]{3}|93[0-4][0-9]{3}"} | json client_ip="transaction.client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" [$__interval])) or on (application) (0 * sum by (application) (count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", container="waf", application=~"$application"}[$__interval])))

panels.title: Top 10 targeted URIs
panels.description: Request URIs with the most audit records containing WAF detections. A record may contain multiple rule matches.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (request_uri) (count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"messages\"" | json request_uri="transaction.request.uri", client_ip="transaction.client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | request_uri!="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Top 10 attacking user agents
panels.description: User-Agents sending traffic that triggers WAF rules.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (user_agent) (count_over_time({job="coraza-waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"messages\"" | json user_agent=`transaction.request.headers["user-agent"][0]`, client_ip="transaction.client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | user_agent!="" [$__range])))

panels.title: WAF inspection latency (p95)
panels.description: Per-application p95 Coraza processing time in milliseconds from audited requests only. RelevantOnly auditing does not sample all normal traffic. Honors the Application and Client IP filters.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {job="coraza-waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"stopwatch\"" | json client_ip="transaction.client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | regexp "combined=(?P<waf_latency_ns>[0-9]+)" | waf_latency_ns!="" | unwrap waf_latency_ns | __error__="" [$__interval]) by (application) / 1000000

panels.title: WAF pod CPU

targets.expr: sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="taskflow", pod=~"taskflow-(frontend|backend)-waf-.*", container="waf", metrics_path="/metrics/cadvisor"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.description: Service-level metric: not affected by the Client IP filter.

panels.title: WAF pod memory

targets.expr: sum by (pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="taskflow", pod=~"taskflow-(frontend|backend)-waf-.*", container="waf", metrics_path="/metrics/cadvisor"})

panels.description: Service-level metric: not affected by the Client IP filter.

panels.title: WAF pod restarts

targets.expr: sum by (pod) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace="taskflow", pod=~"taskflow-(frontend|backend)-waf-.*"}[1h]))

panels.description: Service-level metric: not affected by the Client IP filter.

panels.title: Loki ingester flush failures/s
panels.description: Chunk flush failures per second, deduplicated across the Loki service and headless-service scrapes. This measures storage flush health, not append timeouts. Service-level metric: not affected by the Client IP filter.

targets.expr: sum(max by (instance) (rate(loki_ingester_chunks_flush_failures_total{namespace="monitoring",job="loki"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Alloy forwarding errors

targets.expr: sum(rate(loki_write_dropped_bytes_total[5m]))

panels.description: Service-level metric: not affected by the Client IP filter.

options.content:
**How to read this dashboard**

- **RelevantOnly auditing:** Coraza records only relevant transactions (matched rules or response criteria); normal successful traffic produces no audit records.
- **Interruption vs Detection:** A detection means a rule matched; it is an interruption (BLOCK) only when `transaction.is_interrupted=true`.
- **Top tables and logs:** Tables show ranked top-10 subsets (ties can hide entries); the recent-event log is a sample of at most the latest 100 matching records.
- **Redaction:** Credential headers and sensitive parameters are redacted before Loki ingestion.
- **External edge and host protection:** Direct-to-origin Cilium drops and Cloudflare edge blocks live on the **Blocked Sources** dashboard.
- **Client IP filter:** The `client_ip` textbox (`.*` = all) filters audit-derived panels at query time; pod and infrastructure metrics are service-wide.

panels.title: Raw WAF detection records
panels.description: Latest 100 detection-bearing audit records as stored in Loki, after ingestion redaction. No line_format or rule-description regexp is applied, so the complete stored JSON is available even when a summary field cannot be extracted.

targets.expr: {job="coraza-waf", application=~"$application"} |= "\"messages\"" | json client_ip="transaction.client_ip" | client_ip=~"$client_ip"
